variants.why: reader check of the R02 subdivision-surface face patch (author_face_subd_patch.py as A-face-subd): the starter recipe with no edits is the baseline face (baseline aperture, flat-top triangular pad, two broad tufts per side) rebuilt as a creased quad cage cut into the assembled skin; three blind readers compare it with the baseline before the tool counts as ready
